fields.climate: temperature averages 27-29 degrees Celsius all year long; low humidity, gentle trade winds, brief, intense rain showers; hurricane season stretches from July to November
fields.hazards: subject to hurricanes from July to November
fields.exports: gold, special use vessels, furniture, scrap aluminum, rum
fields.industries: tourism, light industry and manufacturing, heavy industry
fields.languages: French (official), Dutch, English, Guadeloupian Creole, Haitian Creole, Italian, Martiniquan Creole, Papiamento (dialect of Netherlands Antilles), Spanish
fields.religions: Roman Catholic, Jehovah's Witness, Protestant, Hindu

system.text: parliamentary democracy (Territorial Council); overseas collectivity of France
